words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the maritime scene arrive as another exhibit in the surrounding signs sequence, not as a detached scenic aside. Because it is fused into the following {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) frame, connection and sign-classification enter together before the vessels are named. After the warning language of 42:31, the opener bridges denial of independent support into a visible proof owned by God.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) starts with membership in a sign-domain before the eye reaches {{ar:الْجَوَارِ}} ({{tr:al-jawāri}}). Its fronted phrase functions as the predicate of the verbless clause, so the ships are classified as among {{ar:آيَاتِهِ}} ({{tr:āyātihi}}), not introduced first as transport. The partitive force keeps the image sampled from a larger field of evidence rather than making the vessels the whole proof.

words.prose: {{ar:آيَاتِهِ}} ({{tr:āyātihi}}) names the category before the visible subject appears: the ships are first made readable as His signs. The plural and attached suffix keep the evidence multiple and relational, so the scene belongs to God rather than to neutral nature or human craft. The word also begins a sign-to-marker arc that lands on {{ar:الْأَعْلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-aʿlāmi}}); same-surah recurrence around 42:29, 42:33, and 42:35 makes this maritime proof one node in a larger signs argument. The sea-running sign pattern (31:31) is compressed here: the ships themselves are named among His signs, while sea-sign references such as 2:164 keep the setting evidentiary rather than neutral. The disputed derivation does not replace the local sign/proof sense, but it can sharpen the boundary movement from denied outside support in 42:31 into signs owned by Him.

words.prose: {{ar:الْجَوَارِ}} ({{tr:al-jawāri}}) is the delayed subject, so the vessels arrive after they have already been classified as signs. Its active-participial form names them as runners: the ayah points to motion along a course in {{ar:الْبَحْرِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥr}}), not to hulls or human manufacture as the center of attention. The definite collective form turns a familiar class of sea-runners into repeatable evidence, while the next ayah's stilling contrast in 42:33 shows that their running is contingent rather than self-owned. The long-vowel cadence in {{ar:الْجَوَارِ}} ({{tr:al-jawāri}}) stretches into the following locative particle, letting the sound carry the runners toward the sea phrase as the discourse turns from abstract denial to visible motion. The 55:24 parallel with {{ar:الْأَعْلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-aʿlāmi}}) lets the moving ships become visually recognizable markers.

words.prose: {{ar:الْبَحْرِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥr}}) gives the sign its containing field: ordered running matters because it happens inside a vast and unstable expanse. The definite singular presents the sea as one coherent domain, while the concrete noun keeps the scene physical rather than metaphorical breadth. Since the sea phrase precedes the simile, the vessels are first located in the maritime field and only then seen like {{ar:الْأَعْلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-aʿlāmi}}). The preceding locative preposition tightens into the compact sea noun, so the governed enclosure is audible as well as grammatical. Cross-passage sea-running references such as 14:32, 31:31, and 45:12 keep divine enabling near the surface, even though this ayah leaves command or subjection implicit.

words.prose: {{ar:الْأَعْلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-aʿlāmi}}) completes the simile as the governed source term after {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}). The definite plural gives the ships scale and recognizability by likening them to known conspicuous markers, with mountain-like mass and marker-like orientation both useful in the sea scene. The close answers the opening {{ar:آيَاتِهِ}} ({{tr:āyātihi}}), and the 55:24 parallel keeps the runner-landmark formula available while 42:32 frames it as signhood. Its broad final cadence and liquid-nasal weight leave the moving sea scene stabilized on a visible landmark image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the sign noun at index 2, the moving vessels at index 3, the sea at index 5, and the landmark comparison at index 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A moving process becomes conspicuous against a vast medium because the vessels carry the visual scale and distinctness of fixed landmarks. Motion and monumentality cooperate rather than cancel each other.

activation_trace.role: The visibly distinguishing sign image makes the whole scene evidentiary rather than merely scenic.
Uninterrupted running or flowing supplies the scene's mobile process.
Abundant, extensive water supplies the scale against which the moving forms register.
A conspicuous mark that distinguishes and guides supplies the vessels' landmark function.

changed_reading.before: Large ships are among God's signs.
changed_reading.after: The sign is the paradox of immense mobile forms becoming legible like fixed waymarks across an otherwise undifferentiated expanse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The course-bearing sense of the vessels at index 3 and the guiding-mark sense of the comparison at index 6 remain tied to the sea at index 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sea can function as a field of bewilderment; a recurrent course through it and marks visible within it convert disorientation into traversable, readable space.

activation_trace.role: A customary way or repeatedly followed course turns movement into an intelligible route.
The branch's bewilderment image makes the surrounding medium a problem of orientation.
The distinguishing waymark resolves that orientation problem by making a course readable.
The manifest-sign image frames successful orientation itself as what is to be noticed.

changed_reading.before: The sea is a backdrop and the ships are impressive objects.
changed_reading.after: The sea is an orientation problem, and the ships are signs because patterned passage makes a bewildering field legible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sign root at index 2 carries a remote waiting branch while index 3 supplies active flow and index 6 supplies a stable visible mark.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus holds delay, motion, and fixity together: what runs like water is perceived as a standing mark, so the sign can be read as a prompted pause inside ongoing movement.

activation_trace.role: Lingering and waiting introduce a temporal pause into the act of recognizing a sign.
Continuous flow supplies the motion within which that pause occurs.
A stable, conspicuous marker gives perceptual arrest to the flowing object.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents motion for immediate observation.
changed_reading.after: The moving sign asks the observer to linger: perceptual stillness is generated inside physical flow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah removes the wind's force, makes the vessels fixed after motion, and ends with a patience root whose inventory includes a mountain. The focus comparison is thereby enacted: the moving mountain becomes mountain-like by being held still, while the observer's endurance mirrors the vessel's arrested state.

activation_trace.role: Flowing motion supplies the state that the next ayah can visibly suspend.
The landmark image supplies the apparent fixity later made actual.
The specialized stabilization-of-a-vessel image turns generic cessation into controlled nautical arrest.
Wind as effective force identifies what empowers the vessels' motion.
Fixity after movement supplies the explicit reversal from running to arrest.
The mountain branch loops the ethical addressee back into the focus's mountain-like comparison.

structural_cues: 42:33 immediately follows the focus, retains the vessels as its referent, and repeats the sign formula.
The sequence moves from running, to removal of wind, to fixedness, to patience and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical arrest, the mountain comparison, and a patience branch that also names a mountain; I infer an analogy between the vessel's held state and human endurance. A live alternative is that the mountain comparison concerns only visible size and the patience term only addresses observers.

changed_reading.before: The mountain simile magnifies ships while they move.
changed_reading.after: The simile anticipates an ordeal of stillness: the mobile mountain becomes an enacted figure for endurance when its enabling force is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier key-root branch pictures the sea closing around those within it; the immediate sequel then stops motion and permits entrapment or destruction. The sea changes from open transit space into an enclosure whose openness is conditional.

activation_trace.role: The extensive water initially presents an apparently open field of passage.
Free running supplies the apparent mobility that enclosure can revoke.
The branch image of closing the sea upon its occupants supplies the lockable-enclosure mechanism.
Loss of movement shows one way the apparently open medium can cease to function as passage.
Entrapment without release supplies the terminal form of closure.

structural_cues: 42:12 places the key image within control of the heavens, earth, and apportioned provision.
42:33-34 directly converts the focus's free-running vessels into stationary or doomed vessels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical sea-closure image and a later motion-to-entrapment sequence; I infer that they expose conditional access to the sea as a route. The alternative is to keep the key branch lexical and read the later sequel only as weather and destruction.

changed_reading.before: The sea is an open expanse successfully crossed by vessels.
changed_reading.after: The expanse is a controllable enclosure: the same sea that carries can be locked around those it carries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The vessel term can carry delegated agency, while the adjacent earning root pictures productive limbs and the destruction root makes consequences inescapable. The ships become material extensions of their occupants' agency, bearing outward the effects of what those occupants acquire, with pardon interrupting strict consequence.

activation_trace.role: An agent or representative image lets the vessels function as delegated extensions rather than inert objects.
The earning-limbs image supplies the material analogy between human action and the vessels that extend it.
Release from punishment prevents the mechanism from becoming automatic one-to-one retribution.
Destruction supplies the possible material consequence borne by those delegated extensions.

structural_cues: The feminine plural vessel referent continues into 42:34, while the earning clause points to the human occupants.
Destruction, earning, and pardon occur in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel agency, earning limbs, and the adjacency of vessel fate to human earning; I infer an extension relation from occupants to ships. The live alternative is that the ships remain mere instruments and the clause assigns accountability only to their occupants.

changed_reading.before: The vessels display power over nature.
changed_reading.after: They also externalize human agency: mobile works of earning whose fate can disclose consequence, dependence, and pardon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with concealed communication and closes by sequencing messenger, illumination, gentle guidance, and straight path. That sequence sharpens the focus's visible signs and landmarks into a model of mediation: guidance crosses a bewildering interval through carriers and becomes publicly orienting.

activation_trace.role: A manifest sign supplies the visible endpoint of otherwise hidden communication.
The representative or emissarial branch lets the moving vessels model mediated carriage.
Bewilderment supplies the disorienting interval across which guidance must travel.
A distinguishing guide-mark supplies the orienting result of mediation.
Knowledge cast in concealment supplies the surah's initially hidden mode of transmission.
Messenger and message supply the carrier stage between hidden source and received guidance.
A prominent beacon makes transmitted guidance visible at navigational distance.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies the explicit orienting function.
The straight road supplies the destination of the guidance sequence.

structural_cues: Revelation appears near the opening at 42:3 and is anatomized as mediated communication at 42:51.
42:52 closes the sequence with light, repeated guidance, and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealed-message-to-messenger-to-beacon-to-path sequence and focus branches of emissary, bewilderment, and waymark; I infer a functional analogy between vessels crossing water and guidance crossing an unseen interval. The alternative is that the maritime and revelatory sequences remain separate examples of signs.

changed_reading.before: The ships are physical signs that help a viewer read the sea.
changed_reading.after: They become a material analogue of revelation: carriers traverse a disorienting interval and turn hidden transmission into public orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea inventory holds both vast water and thirst that its water does not relieve; the vessel inventory holds continuing provision. Earlier provision is expanded or narrowed, and later rain arrives as relief. The ship thus becomes a channel of apportioned sustenance moving across abundance that cannot itself satisfy need.

activation_trace.role: Continuing provision lets the vessel function as a channel of sustained supply.
Vast abundant water supplies the apparent plenitude surrounding the vessel.
Unrelieved thirst supplies the paradox that surrounding abundance may remain unusable.
Constriction to a small measure makes access to provision controlled rather than equivalent to surrounding quantity.
An apportioned gift supplies the distributive logic governing usable sustenance.
Relief reaching the distressed distinguishes saving water from mere watery abundance.

structural_cues: 42:12 pairs provision with expansion and constriction.
42:28 distinguishes relieving rain after despair from the focus's immense sea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sea's abundance/thirst contrast, continuing provision, measured allocation, and relieving rain; I infer that the vessel mediates usable supply across unusable abundance. The alternative is to treat the thirst branch as lexical distance with no role in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The great quantity of seawater magnifies the ships and their movement.
changed_reading.after: Quantity is not provision: the vessel exposes dependence by carrying apportioned sustenance across water that may surround without relieving.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier praise-root branch carries swimming and running, while the focus names vessels by their running. The shared kinetic image allows maritime flow to echo the surah's earlier cosmic praise without making the ships themselves grammatical agents of praise.

activation_trace.role: Flowing transit supplies the focus's kinetic image.
The manifest-sign frame permits the kinetic echo to carry evidentiary force.
Swimming and running within the praise root supplies a prior cosmic analogue for ordered motion.

structural_cues: 42:5 places the praise action amid heavens near rupture and angelic activity.
42:32 later marks running vessels themselves as signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared running/swimming image; I infer a kinetic echo from cosmic praise to maritime motion. The alternative is ordinary polysemy with no cross-ayah activation.

changed_reading.before: The vessels' running is only transport through water.
changed_reading.after: Their ordered flow can also be heard as a material echo of the surah's earlier cosmic movement of praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mariners' pilot branch is strikingly specific and activates the focus's vessels, but it is distant from the surface use of the Lord noun and must not redefine that title. It remains worth carrying only as a qualified functional analogy of oversight, maintenance, and direction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to the moving vessels at index 3 and sea travel at index 5.

activation_trace.role: Delegated agency makes the vessels responsive carriers within an oversight relation.
Seafaring supplies the concrete domain in which pilotage operates.
The specialized mariners' master image supplies a surprising nautical analogue for governing direction.

changed_reading.before: The ships demonstrate external power over wind and sea.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they can stage governed navigation: delegated carriers whose course depends on continuing oversight analogous to pilotage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ship-propelling pole belongs to a secondary mapped root under the return cue, so the connection is branch-distant and cannot be presented as the surface meaning of the plea for return. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to the focus's running vessels and their traversable sea.

Sea travel supplies the domain for a nautical propulsion image.

A traversable road supplies the route whose absence makes propulsion futile.

changed_reading.before: A vessel's motion suggests that a course can always continue or be corrected.
changed_reading.after: The later no-return plea darkens that confidence: even a means of propulsion is useless where no return-route remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses a form-distant water-mass branch of the comparison root, not the ordinary landmark sense. It remains doubly anchored in the focus's sea and comparison, but downstream prose should mark it as lexical recursion rather than a preferred construal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sea at index 5 is the ground of the comparison, while the comparison root at index 6 unexpectedly contains its own gathered-water branch.

activation_trace.role: The extensive mass of water supplies the scene's surrounding ground.
A concentrated mass of water within the comparator's inventory folds the surrounding medium back into the compared figure.

changed_reading.before: The ships as mountain-like figures stand apart from the sea as their ground.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, figure and ground fold into one another: the comparator itself carries a gathered-water image, making each vessel a bounded concentration of the vastness around it.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequel converts the moving-landmark baseline into enacted endurance by withholding wind and making the vessels fixed.
The keys, stilling, and entrapment branches recast open sea as a conditionally lockable enclosure.
The surah's concealed communication, messenger, beacon, guidance, and path sequence turns maritime orientation into an analogue of revelatory mediation.
The earning-limbs branch makes the vessels material extensions of accountable human agency.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah branch activation repeatedly crossed the focus's physical vocabulary with control, mediation, ethics, and provision without dissolving the vessels, sea, and landmarks into generic themes.
remaining_uncertainties: The patience-to-mountain loop may be deliberate activation or only lexical coincidence reinforced by adjacency.
The provision model depends on a remote thirst branch of the sea root.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Moving vessels become fixed visible marks without ceasing to flow.** Lexical evidence: ج ر ي `B001` (running/flowing), ب ح ر `B001` (wide abundant water) and `B002` (expanse), ع ل م `B002` (distinguishing mark), and ء ي ي `B003` (visible sign). Structural cue and role: the ships' agentive-flowing form is compared to marks or mountains standing out across an expanse. reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Moving vessels become visible landmarks.** **Lexical evidence:** ج ر ي `B001` (running, flowing, and ships sailing), ع ل م `B002` (a distinguishing mark or landmark), and ء ي ي `B003` (a visible sign), anchored in ٱلْجَوَارِ ... كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ. **Structural cue:** a moving noun is compared with fixed visible markers; 42:33 can then stop the wind so the vessels remain motionless. **Assigned role:** motion makes the ships traverse the visual field, while their scale makes them marker-like; the next ayah can literalize the still landmark image. **Abductive move:** I infer that the comparison deliberately holds mobility and apparent fixity together. **Reading change:** the ships are signs because their most impressive motion can be converted into stillness without changing their visible mass.
2. **Expansive medium does not equal autonomous motion.** **Lexical evidence:** ب ح ر `B002` (expanse and breadth) and ج ر ي `B001`, anchored in فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ. **Structural cue:** 42:27-29 described spread, measured descent, and gatherable dispersion; 42:33-34 reveal wind-dependence and possible ruin. **Assigned role:** the sea supplies maximal room to range, while the following condition exposes the external force required to use that room. **Abductive move:** I infer a correction to the visual impression of self-propelled agency. **Reading change:** the vessel's freedom is real but conditional, even in the broadest available arena.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:33 unexpectedly literalized the comparison: the moving landmarks become stationary masses when wind stops. 42:34 corrected any merely spectacular reading by exposing possible ruin, and 42:37 carried the sign into disciplined conduct.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, temel anlamı bir şeyin kendi yolu boyunca akması, koşması ya da ilerlemesi olarak kurar; su, at, rüzgar, güneş ve gemi bunun farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Gemi ve güneş için kullanılan adlandırmalar bu hareket çekirdeğine dayanır, fakat dalın tamamını yalnızca su akışına ya da yalnızca koşmaya indirgemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel ilerleme çekirdeğini kapsar; alışkanlık, aracılık, sürekli gelir ve birlikte hareket anlamları ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hareket çekirdeğini, türemiş biçimlerle belirli söz öbeklerinde görülen su, at, gemi, güneş ve pınar kullanımlarından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendi yolu boyunca akarak, koşarak ya da düzenli biçimde ilerlemesidir. Su, at, rüzgar, güneş ve gemi bu hareketin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; gemi ile güneşin hareketlerine dayalı adlandırmaları çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık kendi yolu boyunca akar, koşar ya da kesintisiz biçimde ilerler.
Su ve rüzgar akarak, at koşarak, güneş ile gemi ise izledikleri yol boyunca ilerleyerek çekirdeği gerçekleştirir.
Hareket eden gemi ve gökte ilerleyen güneş, bu ilerleme özellikleri üzerinden ayrıca adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, bir şeyin yatağında ya da izlediği yolda ilerlemesidir. Hızlı geçiş, suyun akışı, atın koşması, rüzgarın esip gitmesi, güneşin gökte yol alması ve geminin denizde ilerlemesi bu ortak çekirdeğin kapsamındadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş adını tanımlar; insan nitelemesi türemiş bir sözcüksel uzantı olarak bağımlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Doğan veya atmaca türünden bir yırtıcı kuş adıdır. Bu kuş adından türetilen bir niteleme, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği anlatır.

facets.statement: Ad, doğan veya atmaca türünden avcı bir kuşu gösterir.
Kuş adından türeyen insan nitelemesi, çevik ve zeki bir erkeği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığında yırtıcı kuş adı ile bu addan türetilmiş çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesini birlikte sunar.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden kuş için verir ve türemiş biçimi çevik, zeki erkek olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: doğan veya atmaca türü yırtıcı kuş
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın temel kuş adını iki kaynak karşılığı arasındaki seçenekliliği koruyarak açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcı kuş sınıfını ve doğan ile atmaca karşılıklarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adından türemiş insan nitelemesinin kullanıldığı bağlama özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan oluşu ile çeviklik ve zekâ niteliklerini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca karşılığı taşıyan kuş adını ve ondan türeyen insan nitelemesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal mavi renkli, doğan ile atmaca arasında tanımlanan veya beyaz doğan sayılan daha özel bir kuş adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğan ve atmaca çevresindeki avcı kuş adlandırmaları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı kuş alanını paylaşsalar da komşu dal renk ve ara tür özellikleriyle daha dar bir kuşu adlandırır; odak dalın türemiş insan nitelemesi de komşuda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğan veya atmaca türünü genel bir adla karşılar ve bu addan insan nitelemesi türetir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle zeki ve keskin bakışlı doğanlara verilen bir adı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: doğan adı ile zeki doğan nitelemesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal doğan türünden yırtıcı kuşları adlandırır ve zekâ çağrışımını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda zekâ kuştan türetilen insan niteliğinde belirginleşir; komşuda ise doğrudan belirli doğanların özelliğidir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca erkek sırtlanı adlandırır; başka erkek hayvan adları ve benzer sesli su veya kuş adları kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak hayvan adını erkek sırtlanla sınırlar ve başka türlere ya da bağlı kuruluşlara genişletmez.
